caption: The drawing depicts a quilt, composed of nine rectangular blocks arranged in a square grid with three rows and three columns. Each block has a distinct pattern and color scheme, mainly in red, blue, brown, white, and purple, with contrasting central cross-shaped pieces of light color. The blocks are separated and bordered by red sashing with small black and white motifs. Labels with handwritten text are visible in the center of each block, containing names and dates. The lower edge of the quilt includes two white triangular sections with appliquéd red flower motifs, each with a stem and three leaves, set against the quilted white background. The artist's signature "JENNY ALMGREN" appears in the lower right corner of the white background.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
